name: watchverse-notify
description: Free alternative to functions/src/index.ts's notification logic — run from GitHub Actions on a schedule (see .github/workflows/notifications.yml) instead of Cloud Functions, so it works without the Blaze plan. Do not deploy the equivalent Cloud Functions (notifyEpisodesAiringTomorrow/Today, onNewActivity's digest path, flushActivityDigests) alongside this — they'd double-send.
